name: Prototype L7NN
source: Lynn was one of the many Prototypes that fought at the Second Battle of Helion and was ultimately overpowered and defeated by the awakened Sharr of Ryuvia, Asaga di Ryuvia. Out of all her "sisters", Lynn was the only Prototype to survive Asaga's wrath and was soon after taken captive by the Sunrider for interrogation, where she proceeded to begin sowing the seeds of distrust among the crew.
